description: This PHP source file defines the ResetInstallationCommand class, which provides a console command to reset the OrangeHRM application by dropping its databases, removing configuration and key files, and resetting the environment to a clean state.

classes.name: ResetInstallationCommand
classes.description: A Symfony Console command class that resets the OrangeHRM installation by dropping databases and deleting configuration and key files.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the command description to 'Reset OrangeHRM installed instance'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the reset operation: checks if installed, drops databases, removes config and key files, and outputs progress and success messages.
